note: The Monetary Authority of Macao (AMCM) states on its page Currency in Circulation in Macao that the note-issuing banks pay Hong Kong dollars to the AMCM at a fixed rate of HKD 1 to MOP 1.03 under the Linked Exchange Rate System; the page loads by script and was rendered without a bot check; read 2026-10-30.

sources.title: Currency in Circulation in Macao (Monetary Authority of Macao)
sources.said: For the issuance of banknotes, the two Issuing Banks are required to make corresponding payments in Hong Kong dollars to AMCM, at a fixed rate of HKD1 to MOP1.03 under the Linked Exchange Rate System
